displayName: UE4 full-resolution temporal SSAO horizon integration
description: Pixel pass that reconstructs geometry from normal and depth, samples hierarchical depth in multiple horizon directions using frame-varying noise, and packs current ambient occlusion with temporal feedback, reprojection weight, and signed depth.

hashFastPaths.evidence: Live A/B: zero X heavily reduced AO/main shading; zero Y changed an AO-like outline around moving Cloud. Square Enix documents full-resolution temporal SSAO with aggressive denoising and nonlinear baked-AO/capsule-shadow integration.

checks.meaning: The verified AO pass uses one sampler for hierarchical-depth and temporal-history lookups.
A frame-varying 3D noise sequence rotates or jitters the SSAO horizon samples.
Normal, scene depth, AO history, velocity, and hierarchical depth are separate screen-space inputs.
The per-pixel SSAO sample orientation is loaded directly from the 3D noise sequence.
Depth, normal, and velocity or reprojection inputs are fetched at pixel coordinates.
Repeated variable-LOD depth samples evaluate occluding horizons around the shaded point.
Repeated dot products reconstruct and test sample geometry for horizon-based ambient occlusion.
Logarithms select hierarchical-depth mip levels as the AO sampling radius grows.
The packed AO history is sampled at reprojected coordinates for multi-frame feedback.
The pass writes one packed float4 AO temporal intermediate.

runtimeContract.implementation: custom full-resolution temporal SSAO; public Square Enix material does not name a GTAO or HBAO variant
adapterMustConfirm: downstream nonlinear combination with baked AO or capsule shadow
per-channel temporal stability and artifact behavior

knownPacking.x: current nonnegative AO/horizon scalar; live-zero causes major AO/main-shading reduction
knownPacking.y: current or reprojected AO scalar; live-zero changes the moving-character AO outline
knownPacking.z: temporal/reprojection weight or metric; zeroing produced no observable change in the tested scene
knownPacking.w: signed linearized scene depth; zeroing produced no observable change in the tested scene

runtimeContract.controlSafety: Do not uniformly scale xyzw. AO strength is xy = lerp(1.0, original.xy, strength), while temporal metric Z and signed depth W remain unchanged.
